sources.entry: OmniPlan - The best way to visualize, maintain, and simplify your projects. Project Management made easy.

summary.name: OmniPlan
summary.one_liner: OmniPlan is a project management app from The Omni Group for planning complex projects, with scheduling, resource and team calendar features, and critical path analysis.
use_cases: managing multiple projects in a portfolio
comparing progress against the original plan
estimating outcomes with Monte Carlo simulation
tracking budget and value with earned value analysis
summary.what_it_does: OmniPlan 4 lets users set up projects, schedule tasks with manual start and end dates, and track interval and effort. It offers multi-project dashboards for viewing a project portfolio and can pull in team calendars to spot scheduling conflicts and mark violations with suggested fixes. Users can set multiple baselines to compare progress against the original plan, and highlight critical path tasks that affect the completion date. It includes a Monte Carlo simulation feature and built-in Earned Value Analysis formulas for budget and value tracking.
notable: Critical path highlighting of tasks that drive the completion date
Monte Carlo simulation evaluating many potential outcomes in one click
Multiple baselines and built-in Earned Value Analysis formulas
Team calendar integration with scheduling violation detection
caveats: Requires macOS 12 or later, iOS/iPadOS 16 or later, and visionOS 2 or later
Older Macs that do not meet requirements may need a previous version from the downloads archive
